dict.string: Complements official rootless-compat (keep that installed for binary /var/jb string patching). RHCompat focuses on PreferenceLoader/prefs paths + CFPreferences, with light API-level /var/jb remaps. Not a full filesystem virtualization layer.

Rewrites: /var/jb, /Library/PreferenceLoader, /Library/PreferenceBundles, and non-Apple plists under /var/mobile/Library/Preferences when the jbroot copy should win. Respring after changing the toggle.
